name: auto-boilerplate
description: Automatically inserts clean starter boilerplate code and positions the cursor when creating or opening empty files.

commands.title: Auto Boilerplate: Insert Template into Current File

autoBoilerplate.enabled.description: Enable or disable automatic boilerplate insertion.

autoBoilerplate.onOpenEmptyFiles.description: When true, inserts boilerplate into empty files when opened. When false, only newly created files receive boilerplate.

autoBoilerplate.showNotification.description: Show an informational notification whenever a boilerplate template is inserted.
